'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Israeli strikes on Iran]]
****[[Israel]]i leaders announce the "completion phase" of war and order [[IDF|the military]] to strike "economic" targets in [[Iran]] to damage the [[Economy of Iran|Iranian economy]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-shifts-to-hitting-irans-economy-as-it-enters-completion-phase-of-war/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran|Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson]] [[Esmail Baghaei]] says that Iran has not started negotiations with the [[United States]] but also says that the U.S. have submitted a negotiation request. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5808140-iran-us-negotiation-request/ (''The Hill'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
****A missile barrage from Iran and [[Lebanon]] causes a fire at the [[BAZAN Group|BAZAN]] [[oil refinery]] in [[Haifa]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-891624 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****An [[Iran]]ian attack on a [[Energy in Kuwait|power]] and [[desalination|water desalination plant]] in [[Kuwait]] kills an [[Indians in Kuwait|Indian]] worker and damages a building at the site. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/30/iranian-attack-damages-kuwait-power-and-desalination-plant-kills-worker (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Spain in the 2026 Iran war]], [[Spain–United States relations]]
****[[Spain]] closes its [[airspace]] to [[United States Air Force|U.S. aircraft]] involved in [[military operation|military action]] against Iran. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy368j1e3lo (BBC News)]
***[[Syria in the 2026 Iran war]]
****The [[Syrian Army]] says that drone attacks have targeted several of their bases near the [[Iraq–Syria border|Iraqi border]]. However, the Syrian Army also says that several of the drones were shot down and did not say where the drones came from. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-army-says-drone-attacks-targeted-its-bases-near-iraq-2026-03-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza war peace plan]]
****[[Kosovo]] approves the deployment of [[Kosovo Security Force|troops]] to [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] as part of an international [[peacekeeping]] force. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kosovo-approves-troops-gaza-under-us-backed-scheme-2026-03-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***Two [[Indonesians|Indonesian]] [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeepers]] of the [[UNIFIL]] mission are killed in [[Southern Lebanon]] when a projectile hits their vehicle. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gd20evgp0o (BBC News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
***At least 10 people are killed, 25 others are injured and more than 45,000 displaced after [[Somali Armed Forces|Somalia's national army]] ​took control of [[Baidoa]], the capital city of the [[South West State of Somalia|South West state]], two weeks after the state [[List of presidents of South West State of Somalia|president]] [[Abdiaziz Laftagareen]] said that his administration was severing ties with the federal government and opposed [[Constitutional crisis in Somalia|constitutional amendments]] backed by the [[Somali federal government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somali-national-army-takes-control-part-biggest-city-south-west-state-2026-03-30/ (Reuters)] [https://reliefweb.int/node/4204907 (ReliefWeb)] [https://www.bbc.com/somali/articles/c4g829qze8lo (BBC News Somali)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**[[India]] says it has ended the [[Naxalite]] insurgency after [[Minister of Home Affairs (India)|home minister]] [[Amit Shah]] reported that most of the remaining Naxal fighters had been killed, arrested, or had surrendered following intensified [[Indian Armed Forces|security]] operations. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260330-india-declares-victory-over-maoist-insurgency (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Haitian conflict (2020–present)|Haitian conflict]]
**A [[Human rights in Haiti|human rights]] organization in [[Haiti]] claims that the death toll from the previous day's massacre in the [[Artibonite (department)|Artibonite department]] was at least 70 people, higher than official reports. [https://www.dw.com/en/haiti-at-least-70-killed-in-massacre-says-rights-group/a-76600042 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Brent Crude]] [[oil]] passes US$116 per [[Barrel (unit)|barrel]], the highest it has been since the start of the war. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2026/03/30/crude-oil-trump-sends-3500-troops-iran/8301774879238/ (UPI)]
**[[United States]] crude oil settles above US$100 per barrel for the first time in four years. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/30/business/oil-prices-rise-116-iran-intl (CNN)] 
*The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Financial Conduct Authority]] rules that around 12 million people are entitled to [[financial compensation]] after being mis-sold motor finance agreements between 2014 and 2024. The compensation scheme will see each motorist awarded around [[Pound sterling|£]]829, costing [[car finance]] lenders a total of £9.1bn. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9vlm2ggrwlo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and three others are injured after a car crashes between [[Hopefield, South Africa|Hopefield]] and [[Langebaanweg]] in [[Western Cape]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/western-cape-crash-claims-five-lives/ (SABC News)]
*Four people are killed and nine others are injured in an explosion in an under-construction tunnel in [[Chongqing]], [[China]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260331/80e3a7ef6d1f4e35bf97daf4efbde041/c.html (Xinhua)]
*At least 28 people are killed in [[Afghanistan]] and 17 in [[Pakistan]] after heavy [[rain]]fall causes severe [[flood]]ing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/30/heavy-rain-floods-kill-at-least-45-people-in-afghanistan-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*A study published in the [[Carcinogenesis (journal)|Carcinogenesis]] journal shows that [[nicotine]] [[electronic cigarette|vaping]] can cause [[Lung cancer|lung]] or [[Oral cancer|oral cancer]]. [https://www.sciencealert.com/vaping-likely-causes-cancer-major-study-finds (ScienceAlert)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2026 Cuban crisis]]
**[[Cuba–Russia relations]]
***The [[Russia]]n [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] ''Anatoly Kolodkin'', carrying 100,000 tonnes of [[petroleum|crude oil]], arrives in [[Matanzas]], [[Cuba]], despite the ongoing [[United States embargo against Cuba|U.S. blockade of the island]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czrevyx28z2o (BBC News)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[United States]] resumes operations at [[Embassy of the United States, Caracas|its embassy]] in [[Caracas]] after a seven-year closure, aiming to restore direct diplomatic engagement with [[Venezuela]] under [[Delcy Rodríguez]]'s ''[[de facto]]'' [[President of Venezuela|presidency]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2026/03/30/us-embassy-resumes-operations-in-venezuela-after-seven-years/ (AFP via Channels TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
**The [[Islamic Consultative Assembly|Iranian parliament]] security approves a series of measures to impose [[Toll (fee)|tolls]] on vessels that pass through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.lokmattimes.com/international/irans-parliament-security-committee-approves-plan-to-impose-tolls-on-strait-of-hormuz/ (ANI via ''Lokmat Times'')]
*[[Capital punishment in Israel]]
**The [[Knesset]] passes [[Death penalty law (Israel)|a bill]] allowing for mandatory executions of [[Palestinians]] convicted of terrorist attacks that kill [[Israelis]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/30/israel-passes-law-death-penalty-palestinian-convicted-terrorists (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Porepunkah police shootings]]
**[[Victoria Police]] fatally shoot Dezi Freeman, a self-proclaimed [[sovereign citizen]] and fugitive following a seven month manhunt after he killed two police officers and seriously injured another in a shooting in [[Porepunkah]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]]. It was the largest police operation in Australian history. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-04-01/dezi-freeman-identification-victoria-police-shooting/106520654 (ABC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/apr/01/dezi-freeman-porepunkah-killer-police-shooting-sympathy-community-ntwnfb (The Guardian)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/fugitive-accused-killing-two-australian-police-officers-shot-dead-2026-03-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[San Cristóbal school shooting]]
**One person is killed and eight others are injured in a [[school shooting]] in [[San Cristóbal, Santa Fe|San Cristóbal]], [[Santa Fe Province|Santa Fe]], [[Argentina]]. A 15-year-old suspect is taken into custody. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/3/31/school-shooting-in-argentina-leaves-one-dead-eight-wounded-0053 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*The [[Bahrain]]i [[Ministry of Interior (Bahrain)|interior ministry]] says that three men have been arrested for allegedly trying to form a [[terrorist cell]] linked to [[Hezbollah]]. [https://vinnews.com/2026/03/30/bahrain-arrests-3-man-terror-cell-linked-to-hezbollah/ (''VINnews'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Myanmar presidential election]]
**[[Tatmadaw|Myanmar military]] ruler [[Min Aung Hlaing]] steps down as [[Commander-in-Chief of Defence Services|army chief]] to stand as a candidate for [[President of Myanmar|president]] in the upcoming [[President of Myanmar|presidential]] election, the first to be held since the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|2021 coup]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-junta-leader-nominated-presidential-vote-by-mp-2026-03-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mongolia]]'s [[State Great Khural|parliament]] appoints [[Nyam-Osoryn Uchral]] as [[Prime Minister of Mongolia|prime minister]], the third to hold the post within a year, following the resignation of his predecessor, [[Gombojavyn Zandanshatar]], after nine months in office. His appointment follows his removal as [[Chairman of the State Great Khural|parliamentary speaker]] amid opposition protests and a legislative boycott. [https://tribune.net.ph/2026/03/30/mongolia-appoints-third-prime-minister-in-under-12-months (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artemis program]]
**[[NASA]] begins the countdown for the launch of [[Artemis II]], set to be the first crewed mission to the [[Moon]] since [[Apollo 17]] in 1972, with liftoff scheduled for 1 April. [https://www.theregister.com/2026/03/30/countdown_artemis_2/ (''The Register'')]
